newsitem.title: UK: Chrysalis says gains full control of IDTV.
newsitem.headline: Chrysalis says gains full control of IDTV.

text.p: British media company Chrysalis Group said on Friday its CVI Media venture gained full control of IDTV Holdings after paying 12.8 million stg to buy the remaining 51 percent stake controlled by Harry de Winter.

CVI Media is a joint venture between Chrysalis and Dutch publishing and information group NV Verenigd Bezit VNU set up last October to spearhead Chrysalis's expansion into European television production.
Harry de Winter has signed a new five-year agreement to be the chief executive officer of both CVI Media and IDTV.
Chrysalis said 11.2 million stg had been paid on completion of the agreement while the balance of 1.6 million would be paid in 1999, depending on the future profits of IDTV.
